headline: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
summary: AI safety debate intensifies with Dario Amodei's essay "We Must Pace the Frontier." Amodei advocates for slowing down AI development for safety reasons. Various AI leaders and politicians are now weighing in on the crucial discussion.

headline: Trump throws out power plant climate pollution rules
summary: EPA to eliminate greenhouse gas emission standards for US power plants. The move is expected to increase electricity pollution nationwide. This rollback comes as AI, EVs, and manufacturing boost power demand.

headline: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a call from President Trump onstage at the All-In Summit. Huang put Trump on speakerphone, addressing a big crowd. During the call, Trump discussed robots and AI's impact.

headline: Valve's virtual reality plans hit actual reality
summary: Valve's Steam Frame headset is launching, exceeding initial price expectations. The VR device was intended to cost under $1,059 but faces market challenges. Global RAM and storage market impacts are cited for the higher price.

headline: The Popular Budget-Friendly Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D Printer Drops to Just $135 Shipped
summary: The Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D printer is now available for just $135. This deal offers an exceptional entry-level price for 3D printing enthusiasts. The budget-friendly printer includes free shipping.

headline: This Fantasy Party Game Combines Drinking Rules With D&D-Themed Gameplay
summary: A new fantasy party game merges classic drinking rules with D&D mechanics. Experience role-playing fun with an adult twist. The game is currently available on sale.

headline: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma May Have Personally Responded to Your Customer Support Ticket
summary: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has been personally answering customer support tickets. Sharma's first six months included layoffs, price cuts, and a marketing campaign overhaul. She aims to better understand products and customers through direct engagement.

headline: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to $250
summary: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset is now priced at $250. This premium headset offers "infinite battery life" for uninterrupted gaming. Enjoy wireless freedom and zero downtime with this advanced gaming peripheral.

headline: Man admits drugging and raping wife over 20 years
summary: A man pleaded guilty to over 60 offenses, including rape. He admitted to drugging and raping his wife for two decades. The perpetrator's identity is withheld to protect the victim.

headline: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark suggests mandatory AI "kill switches." Most AI labs currently possess methods to "pull the plug" on systems. Clark argues this ability should become a required feature for AI development.

headline: Burnham cancels engagements after death of his father
summary: Burnham has canceled all public engagements following his father's passing. His father, suffering from Alzheimer's, did not know Burnham was Prime Minister. Condolences pour in for the political figure during this difficult time.

headline: Farage says £72m donations are compliant 'with the law today'
summary: Nigel Farage states £72 million in donations comply with current law. Ministers are proposing a £100,000 annual cap on expat donations. The proposed cap would be backdated to March 25, 2026.
